$source=[Drawing.Bitmap]::new("$root/content/images/sprite/mudang_m.png")

# Replace the complete viewer-right eye contour with original pixels.

for($y=171;$y -le 198;$y++){
 for($x=257;$x -le 309;$x++){
  $wx=[Math]::Min(1,[Math]::Min(($x-257)/4.0,(309-$x)/4.0))
  $wy=[Math]::Min(1,[Math]::Min(($y-171)/3.0,(198-$y)/4.0))
  $r=[Math]::Sqrt([Math]::Pow(($x-281)/25.0,2)+[Math]::Pow(($y-184)/11.0,2));$w=[Math]::Max(0,[Math]::Min(1,(1-$r)/0.22))
  if($w -eq 0){continue}
  $a=$source.GetPixel($x,$y);$b=$before.GetPixel($x,$y)
  $after.SetPixel($x,$y,[Drawing.Color]::FromArgb($b.A,[int][Math]::Round($a.R*$w+$b.R*(1-$w)),[int][Math]::Round($a.G*$w+$b.G*(1-$w)),[int][Math]::Round($a.B*$w+$b.B*(1-$w))))
 }
}
$after.Save("$out/mudang_m-sad-preview.png",[Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$outside=0;$eye=0;$alpha=0;$changes=0
for($y=0;$y -lt 1280;$y++){for($x=0;$x -lt 512;$x++){
 $a=$source.GetPixel($x,$y);$b=$before.GetPixel($x,$y);$c=$after.GetPixel($x,$y)
 if($c.ToArgb() -ne $b.ToArgb()){$changes++;if($x -lt 257 -or $x -gt 309 -or $y -lt 171 -or $y -gt 198){$outside++}}
 if([Math]::Pow(($x-281)/25.0,2)+[Math]::Pow(($y-184)/11.0,2) -le 0.60 -and $a.ToArgb() -ne $c.ToArgb()){$eye++}
 if($b.A -ne $c.A){$alpha++}
}}
$check=[pscustomobject]@{changedPixels=$changes;changesOutsideRightEyePatch=$outside;eyeContourDifferencesFromOriginal=$eye;alphaChanges=$alpha;femaleChanged=$false;gameIntegrated=$false}
$check | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$out/check.json" -Encoding utf8
$check | Format-List
$source.Dispose();$before.Dispose();$after.Dispose()
foreach($v in @(@{id='mudang_f';title='여자 무당';top=157},@{id='mudang_m';title='남자 무당';top=78})){

 $g.DrawString('슬픔 수정본',$label,[Drawing.Brushes]::DimGray,544,65)

 $g.DrawImage($b,[Drawing.Rectangle]::new(536,105,504,465),$src,[Drawing.GraphicsUnit]::Pixel)
